rows.en:
No!!

No, no! I have to pull myself together! All right!
Anne, you get out of here!

No, no! Absolutely not!

I'm not running away, no matter what!
Heh heh heh… Will you accept our challenge?
"Our"?
That's right…

Let's quit this nonsense!

Anne, report to the base. I'll handle them somehow!
No, no… I'm pretty skilled myself, you know! Don't underestimate me…
No… reporting to the base comes first!
But…
Come on, hurry! Hurry!!
Okay!
It seems… it's just us now.

…!?

Windom, go!
HQ, please respond!! This is Anne!
What's wrong!?
Captain! We're surrounded by Alien Guts and can't move!
You're no match for us…

…!?

Windom, come back!
If you underestimate our power… there'll be needless victims!!
Dan! Let's break through with a missile attack!!

Wait, Anne!!

…!?

Here they come!! Anne, your seatbelt…!
Ultraseven didn't come out! At this rate, we can't analyze Seven's abilities.
In that case… we'll just ask Dan himself directly!

I see…

Those pranks since yesterday must have been that Alien Guts!

Right? Am I right?

…Senpai! Everyone figured that out ages ago!

The problem is… what exactly is Alien Guts trying to do?

"When Anne and Soga went out on patrol… nothing was wrong!

When Furuhashi and Amagi went out, nothing changed either…

And yet, it was when I went out that Alien Guts targeted us…

In that case, the enemy is after me! But why would they target me?"
This is Kiriyama. What is it?
Captain! There seems to be something about 10,000 meters above Lake Kawaguchi.
Something's there?
Yes… The radar is picking it up, but we can't see anything.
All right, keep patrolling that area!

Ah…

Captain, wait a moment. Amagi, look at that!
Captain! It's revealed itself! It's a spaceship!
Soga, Dan! Head out in the Pointer and back them up at once!
Roger!
Wait… Do you think you can beat Alien Guts?
Uwaaaagh…
Soga!!

Captain!

Soga has been carried off by Alien Guts near Aokigahara lake! Requesting immediate rescue!!
All right, roger!!
So you've finally become Seven? I've been waiting for you!
Any moment now… Seven's energy will run out!
Ah… Ultraseven!
Damn it… I'll fight them to the bitter end!
No, no! Amagi… there's no way we can win by pushing it!
Kuh… All right, let's pull back for now!
Amagi! Hey, are you all right!?
Yes, sir! I'm all right.
What happened to Soga and Dan?
They were kidnapped by Alien Guts…
What!?
Captain! It's Alien Guts!!
Th-those guys are the Naager's…
Damn it… Is the space fortress finally starting its attack too!?
Captain!

Hmm… The TDF has turned all its forces on that space fortress too…

We'll fight this one on our own!!
Hah hah hah… Awake now, are you? Welcome, Ultraseven!

…!?

How do you know that?
Heh heh heh… There's something I'd very much like you to see!
Ah…!?
Well?
What do you plan to do, building something like this?
It's only natural that we, the invincible, would model ourselves on the superman Ultraseven, isn't it?
Ultraseven is the Earthlings' ally!

And soon… he'll become mankind's greatest enemy!

The Earthlings will think Ultraseven is an invader… The champion of justice will become a byword for the devil!
What!? I won't let that happen!

Heh heh heh… And so, I have a favor to ask you!

Our Seven is almost complete… but one thing is missing! The Ultra Beam. We want to know the beam's secret!
The Ultra Beam's…?

Our Seven was built with the cooperation of Alien Salome and the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, and is utterly invincible!

With abilities surpassing even Giant Devil, it can defeat even the real Seven!!

Our Seven was built with the cooperation of Alien Salome and the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, and is utterly invincible!

By our calculations, it can defeat even the real Seven!!
It can't be helped… We'll use the Talk Machine.
Talk Machine ready!!
All right, switch it on!
Now, tell us the secret of the Ultra Beam!
Ugh… M… 2… S… H… 3… G… W… F… D… 1… Ugh… ugh…

Good, well said!

With this, we can make the Ultra Beam. Now our Seven will be complete too! Hah hah hah…

…!?

Captain! Seven is…!?

Attention, all mankind of Earth! If you keep up your attacks, you will only be wiped out…

The Ultra Garrison's trump card, Ultraseven, is in our hands!

Your hero Ultraseven will be executed at dawn…
Good grief…

uncertain: U15225: Dan picks up on 'our' (Alien Guts speaks as a group).
U15246: 先輩 rendered 'Senpai' (Soga to Furuhashi).
U15260: 青木ヶ原湖 rendered 'Aokigahara lake'.
U15284: 披う is unclear; read as 倣う ('model ourselves on'), matching their fake Seven. Could also be 狙う ('target').
U15296: the code string M2SH3GWFD1 kept as spelled out.
U15288-U15297: ウルトラビーム rendered 'Ultra Beam'; トークマシン 'Talk Machine'.
